newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, enquiries improve.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, enquiries improve.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes hovered around recent levels Tuesday with a decline in crude offset by a higher level of enquiries, traders said.
"Enquiries are better today, though not significantly good," said a major supplier, adding that bunker levels were still supported by a firm cargo market.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were offered at around $100 per tonne while the 380-cst grade was offered around $103.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at around $160 and $170 per tonne respectively.
